title: Shaping & Monitoring Models through their Internal Representations
abstract: arXiv:2611.07071v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We propose Mechanistic Shaping, a unified framework for shaping models through their internal representations. Mechanistic Shaping is applied during training so that models follow specifications (rules) about which concepts they express, measured via their outputs or internal representations (e.g., no harmful content), and also which concepts they rely on, i.e., what they use to make their decisions (e.g., not a candidate's gender when screening a r\'esum\'e). Across multiple domains (vision, medical imaging, language), scales (up to 32B parameters), and training paradigms (classification, SFT, DPO, GRPO), we find that Mechanistic Shaping substantially reduces targeted behaviors while preserving task performance. Since training against a representation can also modify it, we ask whether shaped concepts remain monitorable, a question that depends on the class of monitors considered. translated_title: 通过内部表示来塑造与监控模型
translated_abstract: 我们提出了“机制塑造”，这是一个通过模型内部表示来塑造模型的统一框架。机制塑造在训练过程中应用，使模型遵循关于它们表达哪些概念的规范（规则）（通过其输出或内部表示来衡量，例如不产生有害内容），以及它们依赖哪些概念，即它们用来做决策的依据（例如在筛选简历时不依赖候选人的性别）。跨越多个领域（视觉、医学影像、语言）、多种规模（最高达32B参数）和多种训练范式（分类、SFT、DPO、GRPO），我们发现机制塑造能在保持任务性能的同时显著减少目标行为。由于针对某一表示进行训练也可能改变该表示本身，我们提出了一个问题：被塑造的概念是否仍然可被监控，而这一问题取决于所考虑的监控器类别。因此，我们引入了此类类别的一个层级体系……
tldr: 该论文提出“机制塑造”统一框架，在训练中通过约束模型内部表示所表达和依赖的概念来塑造模型行为，在多领域、多规模、多训练范式下显著减少不良行为同时保持任务性能，并引入监控器类别的层级体系来评估被塑造概念是否仍然可被监控。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Mechanistic Shaping, a unified framework that shapes models during training by constraining which concepts they express and rely on in their internal representations, substantially reducing targeted behaviors while preserving task performance across domains, scales, and training paradigms, and further introduces a hierarchy of monitor classes to assess whether shaped concepts remain monitorable.
